description: 水利署地層下陷GNSS測站基本資料 [GNSS positioning and satellite positioning] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集提供全臺地層下陷地區水利署所屬GNSS連續固定站之基本資訊，目前署內共計有33個GNSS固定站，包括彰化西港國小、新生國小、湖南國小、溪州國小、雲林新興國小、土庫國中、客厝國小、光復國小、林內國中、宏崙國小、中科虎尾、明德國小、豐榮國小、水燦林國小、宜梧國中、秀潭國小、元長國小、安南國小、南光國小、龍巖國小、拯民國小、山內國小、舊... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
